name: SCRATCH
source:
Scratch is the story of a young reporter sent on a strange assignment. Rather than a simple interview, he finds himself in the shady part of town enticed into a gamble where the stakes could put his reputation and entire future on the line. 

Join "Hirosaki Wajin" on this short adventure that will test your memory and your patience in this soft yaoi game. A game of chance, a game of cards and many surprises await in this short mind bending adventure, that can turn a mild mannered photographer into a slightly twisted voyeur.

[From [url=http://yaoigamesenglishtranslations.weebly.com/scratch.html]Blackwidow Productions[/url]]
translation:
《Scratch》讲述了一位年轻记者被派去执行一项奇怪任务的故事。他发现自己不是在接受一次简单的采访，而是在小镇的阴暗处，被引诱进入一场赌博，赌注可能把他的声誉和整个未来置于危险之中。

加入“弘前和人”的短暂冒险，在这款柔软的妖追游戏中考验你的记忆力和耐心。在这场短暂而令人费解的冒险中，一场机会游戏、一场纸牌游戏和许多惊喜等待着你，它可以将一个温和的摄影师变成一个有点扭曲的偷窥者。

[来自[url=http://yaoigamesenglishtranslations.weebly.com/scratch.html]Blackwidow Productions[/url]]
